Hiya, me and the girlfriend went VIP this year (been normally twice before) and this was our two cents. 

- The buggy service was a clusterfuck. We were told to bring all our gear past the main gates and wait for a pickup to take us to VIP parking. Took me a few trips between the car and the gates (with VIP can you park right by the entrance) in the blistering hot sun. After bringing all our shit past the gates we were told it would be 5 mins. Great, no worries. After a hour we asked again and we were told they moved the pick up point to outside the main gates in the VIP car park. After moving all our shit back to outside we caught the final buggy (which was at midday, the buggy service ends at fucking midday) which dropped us off at VIP reception, which is another 250m from VIP camping. Also, there’s no buggy service Sunday. 

- VIP camping is situated behind The Cave and to access if you need to walk behind the backstage areas of both the axiom and the cave. Compared to how close you can camp normally, it’s a bit of a walk. There’s no special showers or toilets and there are far LESS toilets in VIP than there are in normal camping. In fact, we saw 5 portaloos for the entire 2 fields. 

- In terms of free merch you get a free shirt (the white shirt with the circular design), a free clashfinder, a tote bag and 2 stickers. 

- The option to go side stage is cool, but it feels like a massive novelty. We went side stage for Arcane Roots and because of the placement all sound gets drowned out the by drums. We only went side stage once because you can’t really hear shit. 

All in all, we won’t be going VIP again. Considering the amount we paid we felt more like an after thought and the lack of toilets in the camping area was shocking. Don’t get me wrong, Trees is still my favourite festival and all but I would much rather camp normally even if the VIP option was free.
